title: Ambient finite open Cartesian tensor calculus
statement: For a coefficient datum c and finite extension E, positive level n+1 and compactified square Q, there exist precisely unit-normalized intrinsic finite maps d : FiniteMaps, and for arbitrary ambient derived K on X and P on Z their open projection/base-change square commutes. There is no constructibility or Tor hypothesis on K or P. The displayed identity is OpenIdentityAt with the actual finite tensor, canonical pullback comparisons, and canonical geometric square comparison [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso].

proof.text: Localize the exact open adjunction and use the canonical K-flat tensor model. The open projection inverse is the open-unit transpose followed by inverse tensor pullback. Open localization gives its invertibility, and Cartesian open base change gives invertibility of the canonical reverse exchange mate. Naturality assembles these into FiniteMaps with both specified transpose equations and beta inverse equal to the specified mate.

proof.text: Transpose the inverse tensor square under the base-changed open adjunction. Substitute the normalized inverse projection and exchange transposes. Naturality moves the geometric square comparison and tensor comparison past each other. Monoidality of the canonical composition comparison identifies the middle factors. The open-unit naturality and the base-changed projection transpose identify the remaining factors. Adjunction injectivity and cancellation give the stated forward equality on arbitrary unbounded inputs.

theorem finite_open_cartesian_calculus (n : ℕ) (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D) :
    ∃ d : FiniteMaps D c E n Q,
      ∀ (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory Q.X.obj.left (finiteCoefficientRing c.l E (n + 1)))
        (P : proEtaleDerivedCategory Q.Z.obj.left (finiteCoefficientRing c.l E (n + 1))),
  OpenIdentityAt
    (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor c.l E Q.X.obj.left n)
    (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor c.l E Q.Z.obj.left n)
    (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor c.l E Q.X'.obj.left n)
    (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor c.l E Q.Z'.obj.left n)
    (finiteDerivedPullback c.l E n Q.h.hom.left)
    (finiteDerivedPullback c.l E n Q.g'.hom.left)
    (finiteDerivedPullback c.l E n Q.i.hom.left)
    (finiteDerivedPullback c.l E n Q.i'.hom.left)
    (finiteOpen D c E n Q) (finiteOpen' D c E n Q)
    (fun N T ↦ d.gamma.hom.app (N, T)) (fun N T ↦ d.gamma'.hom.app (N, T))
    d.beta.hom.app K P
    ((finiteMu D c E Q.g' n K
      ((finiteDerivedPullback c.l E n Q.i.hom.left).obj
        P)).hom)
    ((finiteMu D c E Q.h n ((finiteOpen D c E n Q).obj K)
      P).hom)
    ((sfIntrinsicDerivedSquarePullback (finiteCoefficientRing c.l E (n + 1))
      Q.g'.hom.left Q.i'.hom.left Q.i.hom.left Q.h.hom.left Q.openSquare.w).hom.app
        P)
